target: pinned public VABench evaluation of released H3 outputs
required_before_a_score_bearing_run: Pin every evaluator weight actually used, including LFS object SHA-256 values and all non-cache dependency revisions.
Resolve and record the mapping/final_idx_to_prompt.csv versus mapping_text/final_idx_to_prompt.csv path defect without silently changing the official claim.
Obtain an author-supplied I2AV image-to-annotation pairing manifest. Neither filename matching, lexical order nor ZIP order is a valid replacement.
Pass a small official-subset end-to-end smoke with complete video, audio and JSON coverage.
Record H3 model revision, sampler/request settings, seed, media metadata, evaluator environment and per-item outputs.
Verify all 15 configured dimensions or explicitly freeze a smaller metric suite before reporting any aggregate.
known_release_blockers: Official code repository has no top-level license file.
The official repository has one reachable snapshot commit, making historical code provenance unavailable from its Git history.
Official mapping loader names a directory not present in the snapshot.
The official I2AV images and JSON annotations have no published join key or pairing manifest; equal per-category counts do not establish sample identity.
The released DNSMOS wrapper imports third_party/DNS-Challenge/DNSMOS/dnsmos_local.py, but that implementation is absent and no Git submodule pins it.
Official config does not pin component model revisions or hashes.
VABench public resources do not provide an H3 baseline output set or an H3 training protocol.
A current four-GPU H3 service window is unavailable: on 2026-09-18 only GPU 0 was free on the checked host.

annotation_mapping.pairing_audit: all 521 audit-copy image hashes match the remote inventory; lexical and ZIP order do not align with JSON order
